problem: A natural current Project Intelligence problem could select a recent canonical Experience, yet still fail to recover the initial differently-keyed historical Experience because problem-only History retrieval did not traverse existing Experience provenance or exact assignment identity.

decision.decision_summary: Add only a read-only structural bridge over explicit source/correction Experience IDs and exact shared assignment_ref. Preserve every original goal_ref and CR-15/16/17 provenance contract; do not introduce semantic search, vectors, RAG, keyword tags or incident-specific rules.

action.action_summary: Extended the existing canonical History retrieval service and verifier; proved Incident #2/#3 retrieval and a real unrelated negative control; ran all existing GENIE regressions.

evidence.evidence_detail: Incident #2 and #3 recovered the initial differently-keyed Experience through explicit canonical edges; unrelated GPU/ComfyUI controls returned zero bridge records; 11/11 pre-capture GENIE regressions passed at 114 canonical Experiences.

cause.root_cause_summary: The necessary relationships already existed in canonical records, but the problem-only History operation stopped at repository JSON evidence and exposed no Experience-to-Experience traversal path.

lesson: A key mismatch does not require reclassification when canonical records already preserve exact relational evidence: keep the historical key intact and add a bounded traversal over explicit provenance and shared real assignment identity, with an unrelated negative control to prevent relevance inflation.
